text:
Maya: dropping the near-final blog draft here. Need fast eyes on headline, benchmark callout, webinar CTA copy, and inbound routing. comments enabled: https://docs.google.com/draft/redwood-go-live (pls tag changes).

Evan: on it. can we avoid the word 'revolutionary' in the opener? feels hype-y.

Maya: agree. changed to 'production-grade improvements' in doc.

Tasha: benchmark paragraph is sticky. suggest: 'In internal throughput tests, Redwood served steady-state traffic with 30-40% lower per-token latency on quantized models vs our baseline.' we should pick a single number or a range?

Ravi: range is safer. add the caveat: 'results from 8k-seq microbench with batch fusion enabled; customer workloads may vary.'

Nina: copy edit pass complete 14 removed passive voice, shortened the subhead. left one alt hero headline.

legal-bot: Reminder: no superlatives like 'fastest' or 'best'. Include methodology link and partner consent for any quotes. I added the standard methodology snippet in doc.

Maya: thanks legal-bot. I'll paste the microbench link and the methodology footnote.

Evan: webinar CTA options live in the doc. A: 'Save your seat 14 Live demo + Q&A' B: 'Join our Optimize webinar 14 regional sessions'. which is higher intent?

Tasha: A is higher intent but longer. B is friendlier for top funnel. lean B.

Ravi: B as well. also request a session-level hidden field: session_region + audience_tier for routing into nurture.

ops-bot: recommended UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=content, utm_campaign=optimize_go_live, utm_term={audience}, utm_content={cta_variant}. webinar form: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=registration, utm_campaign=optimize_go_live_demo, add hs_form_guid and session_region hidden fields.

Maya: perfect, i'll wire those hidden fields into the HubSpot form and add the tracking snippet to the post template.

Nina: also we have an approved customer blurb from Atlas Labs 14 permission to use short quote. I placed it near the benchmark paragraph.

legal-bot: Confirmed: Atlas quote approved per CMO email; use exact attribution: 'Atlas Labs, ML Platform Lead'.

Evan: small factual check on numbers: earlier internal runs showed median improvement around 33% at 2x throughput. can we phrase as 'median improvements ~33% under our 8k microbench at 2x throughput'?

Ravi: that matches my notes. add 'quantized 4-bit model tests' in parentheses.

Maya: I'll merge: "median improvements ~33% (8k microbench, 2x throughput, quantized 4-bit models); results may vary." short and footnoted.

design-bot: Heads up: need final hero image by EOD to meet the publish slot. prefer 1200x630, asset request in design queue.

Maya: pinged design and linked hero direction in doc.

Tasha: CTA variant vote: B. also recommend A/B test copy: 'Join the webinar' vs 'Save your seat'. we can map utm_content accordingly.

Evan: agree to A/B. i'll add variants to the doc and label them CTAv1/CTAv2.

ops-bot: After publish, file inbound-playbook ticket: route blog->nurture:top-funnel, webinar signups->nurture:product-intent, add hs_form_guid mapping and session_region audience split.

Maya: timeline: if we accept final edits in 2 hours I can queue publish for tomorrow morning and trigger the webinar landing page. Can folks jump on quick passes?

Nina: i'll finish copy pass in 30m.

Ravi: will add the microbench link and methodology note now.

Evan: done - accepted headline change and removed 'revolutionary' in doc.

Maya: thanks all. final asks: 1) legal confirm methodology footnote wording; 2) ops confirm hidden fields wired; 3) design deliver hero by EOD. i'll lock the CTAs as variant B+CTAv2 unless someone objects within 90m. :rocket:

legal-bot: Methodology footnote approved. Avoid absolute language elsewhere.

ops-bot: Hidden fields noted in form config: hs_form_guid, session_region, audience_tier. will create the inbound-playbook ticket after publish.

Maya: locking CTAv2-B in 60m if no objections. thanks team 14 will update once scheduled.
note: One Slack thread; concise messages in Slack style, includes bots and UTMs. Chronological order preserved.
